desc: Prove that reversals preserve the unordered rooted-forest structure and enable arbitrary sibling permutations and embeddings.
Parse the parenthesis string into a rooted forest and determine canonical unordered-tree identifiers bottom-up.
Derive and implement the recurrence using multinomial factors for equal canonical types.
Use sorted child-type tuples for efficient canonicalization within the constraints.
Verify repeated subtrees, multiple top-level components, empty interiors, and modular factorial arithmetic.
